title: On Turán's inequality: new general criteria, nonnegative representations and the class of generalized Chebyshev polynomials
summary: Originally, Turán's inequality states that if $(P_n(x))_{n\in\mathbb{N}_0}$ is the sequence of Legendre polynomials, then $Δ_n(x):=P_n^2(x)-P_{n+1}(x)P_{n-1}(x)\geq0$ for all $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and $x\in[-1,1]$. Gasper specified the parameters $α,β>-1$ for which the Jacobi polynomials $(R_n^{(α,β)}(x))_{n\in\mathbb{N}_0}$ satisfy Turán's inequality. Frequently, such results rely on the specific structure of the concrete orthogonal polynomials under consideration.
